title: [task] XL330-CN bus-value bring-up + 0x55 frame anomaly (HAT TTL cont.)
body:
## Goal
Finish bring-up of the XL330-CN on the **HAT TTL** path, and settle the one open protocol question. Continuation of #4 — see the closing verdict there ([comment](https://github.com/ScrapMeta/microduck-diy/issues/4)).

## What #4 already proved (do not redo)
- **HAT TTL is reachable.** Read-only scan on `/dev/ttyS2` got an ID 1 / model 1200 reply at **57 600**; `/dev/ttyS2` present · getty masked · `fuser` clean · `overlays=uart2-m0` · `console=display` **live this boot**.
- The old "zero reply" was **not a hardware fault**: the servo was still **factory state (ID 1 @ 57 600)** and had never been written to the bus values, plus `scripts/dxl_ping.py` had a CRC-scope bug whose fake servo reused the same error (self-test green while packets were malformed).
- Baseline captured → `xl330-cn-bench-kit.md`.
- Bench params ruled: **6.0–6.5 V** (6.0 preferred); current limit **1 A bare HAT / 2–3 A with Zero**, set **before** power-up.

## Remaining (this Issue)
1. **[load-bearing] Settle the extra `0x55` byte.** This kit's status frame is
   `HEADER · ID · LEN · 0x55 · ERROR · DATA · CRC` with `LEN = len(DATA) + 4` (spec: `+3`).
   The byte is on the wire **and covered by the servo's own CRC** (14/14 frames consistent), so it comes from the servo, not our path.
   One-shot test: same servo on **U2D2 + Dynamixel Wizard** (independent implementation) — does `0x55` appear there too?
   - If **yes** → document as a firmware deviation of the CN variant; state whether `robotd`/`rustypot` (spec implementation) can parse it, or whether CN servos are bench-only.
   - If **no** → the HAT path introduces it; that becomes a hardware finding.
2. **Scope** (the evidence #4 owed): idle DATA ≈ 3.3 V · ping host packet · reply packet. Same probes/wording as `hat-dxl-bus-debug.md` §4.
3. **Write the bus values** — ID and baud to the bus's values (via `robotd` / Wizard; `dxl_ping.py` is deliberately read-only) — then **re-verify at 1 Mbps**. Until this is done the servo is still not "brought up".
4. **Bench-verify the parameters** that are still only ruled, not measured: `1 A` / `2–3 A` staging · J13 pin 2 · 5 V / 3V3.

## Spec (wiki)
- Steps: `microduck-diy/wiki/concepts/hat-dxl-bus-debug.md`
- Method / params / probe order / consistency baseline: `dxl-bench-method.md`
- Script: `scripts/dxl_ping.py` (+ `scripts/README.md`)
- Baseline: `xl330-cn-bench-kit.md` · entity: `dynamixel-xl330.md`

## Constraints
- Supply **6.0–6.5 V**; current limit set **before** power-up per configuration. Never 7.4 V into the servo.
- One servo only. **Single variable per attempt** — say which one in the comment.
- No Type-C + `+BATT` dual feed. RS-485 (U8/J3/J11) not needed.
- `dxl_ping.py` stays **read-only**; register writes go through `robotd` / Wizard.
- Do not read the kit's values through spec-only parsing and report them — that yields `error=0x55` and every register shifted by one byte (`max_voltage_limit = 1792.0 V` looks plausible and is wrong).

## Acceptance
- [ ] `0x55` origin settled (U2D2 + Wizard cross-check), with raw frames attached either way
- [ ] `robotd` / Wizard can drive or read the servo **at 1 Mbps** (bus values written)
- [ ] Scope: idle DATA ≈ 3.3 V, host packet, reply packet attached
- [ ] Current-limit staging + pin 2 / 5 V / 3V3 measured and recorded
- [ ] Wiki updated **and pushed**; comment this Issue with raw output
- [ ] `ready-for-pm`

## assignee-agent
hardware (bench); pm tracks

title: [task] imu-to-dxl v0.3 firmware P0 fixes + rebuild

milestone.title: v0.1
milestone.description: 复刻官方 Microduck，实现基础功能。

body:
## Type
`task`

## Goal
基于 v0.3 硬件真源修复 `imu_to_dxl` 固件的启动、SFLP 与 DXL 通信缺陷，重新生成可追溯 ELF/BIN，并完成单板 U2D2 烧录验收。

本任务是 #7 零回包台架任务的固件实现单；#7 保留为实板联调/波形验收。

## Confirmed root causes / defects
1. `SPI1_CR2` 仅设置 8-bit DS，未设置 `FRXTH=1`；首个 8-bit SPI 接收可能永久等待 `RXNE`，发生在 DXL 主循环之前，可直接解释首包 RX=0 B。
2. LSM6DSV16X SFLP/FIFO 配置值不正确：game rotation FIFO enable、SFLP ODR 固定位、game init 位。
3. FIFO tag 位于 bit7:3，当前解码方向错误。
4. USART2 RX 在发送期间常开，PA3 与 U6-Y/DXL_DATA 同网；Status 自回听且未清 `RDR/ORE`，会破坏后续请求。
5. SPI/USART 等待无超时；Protocol 2.0 TX/RX 缺 byte stuffing；Read/Write 长度边界不足。

## Non-negotiable contracts
- 硬件：v0.3 · STM32G031F8P6 · LSM6DSV16X · SN74LVC1G125，OE# `PA1`，低电平发送。
- DXL：Protocol 2.0 · ID `200` · `1 Mbps`。
- 主机数据：addr `124` · `12 B`；gyro `i16 LE ×3` + quaternion xyz `IEEE half LE`。
- 保留 #6 的 `GPIOA_BASE = 0x50000000` 修复。
- 以 ST 官方 LSM6DSV16X driver/datasheet/AN5763 与 STM32G031 RM0444 为寄存器依据，不凭同系列芯片猜值。

## Required implementation
### Phase A — restore DXL lifeline
- [ ] SPI 8-bit RX 阈值配置正确，并为 SPI/USART 所有轮询等待增加有界超时。
- [ ] IMU WHO_AM_I/init 失败不得阻塞 DXL 主循环；诊断表能区分 `DXL alive / IMU failed`。
- [ ] 处理 TX 自回听：发送期间禁用 RE，或发送后可靠 drain RDR 并清 ORE/FE/NE；给出选择依据。
- [ ] 标准 Ping Status（Model Number + Firmware Version）与普通 Read 可用。

### Phase B — restore IMU/SFLP data
- [ ] 修正 SFLP game rotation FIFO enable、ODR、INIT 与寄存器写后 readback。
- [ ] FIFO tag 按 `(tag_byte >> 3) & 0x1F` 解码并识别 game rotation tag。
- [ ] addr124 的 gyro/quaternion 非固定零，姿态变化方向合理。

### Phase C — protocol robustness
- [ ] Protocol 2.0 TX stuffing / RX unstuffing，Length 与 CRC 基于线上的 stuffed packet 正确计算。
- [ ] Read/Write/Status 缓冲区全部有硬边界，越界请求返回明确错误，不静默截断/越界写。
- [ ] 增加 `sync_read(0x82)`、stuffing、自回听/ORE、超长读写的 host tests。
- [ ] 评估并解决 1 Mbps 下 SPI drain 阻塞 UART 的风险（RX IRQ + ring buffer，或有测量依据的等效方案）。

## Deliverables
- 固件源码：`imu_to_dxl/firmware/`
- 构建产物：`firmware/build/imu_to_dxl.elf`、`.bin`（产物可不入 Git，但 Issue 必须记录 commit/hash/size）
- 测试记录：本 Issue 评论；涉及规格变更时更新对应 wiki/docs

## Acceptance
- [ ] `make clean && make host-test && make g031` 全部 exit 0。
- [ ] 记录 commit、ELF/BIN SHA-256 与 `arm-none-eabi-size`。
- [ ] SWD/隔离验证证明启动不再停在 SPI RXNE 等待。
- [ ] 单挂 ID200：连续 Ping 与 Read(124,12) 各 1000 次，无丢包/CRC 错。
- [ ] `duck-control` 同路径 Sync Read（ID200 为首设备）连续运行 10 min，无 timeout/ShortRead。
- [ ] @136 诊断能区分 IMU present/SFLP live；quat 达到 ready 并随姿态变化。
- [ ] 含 `FF FF FD` 的 12 B 载荷通过 stuffing 抓包/主机解码测试。
- [ ] 结果回写 Issue，完成后加 `ready-for-pm`，由 pm 验收关闭。

## assignee-agent
`software`（固件/协议）；`hardware` 仅在 #7 配合烧录、波形和供电台架；`pm` 验收。

## References
- #6 GPIOA base 修复
- #7 v0.3 U2D2 zero-reply bring-up
- `imu_to_dxl/docs/hardware.md`
- `imu_to_dxl/docs/protocol.md`
- `wiki/concepts/imu-to-dxl-firmware-build.md`

title: [task] eval: body IMU power rail ~6V via DXL 3P to HAT

milestone.title: v0.1
milestone.description: 复刻官方 Microduck，实现基础功能。

body:
## Type
`task`（设计评估 · 未授权改板/改拓扑前勿装机定稿）

## Goal
评估一条**备选供电路径**：机身侧取电 → **降到约 6 V**（是否还需稳压）→ 经 **DXL 3P（针 2 = VBATT）** 给头舱 **HAT** 供电；并厘清与机身 IMU（ID 200）接口/铜箔/保护的关系。

对照现行 wiki 定稿（**不要默认替换**）：
- `board-interconnect`：`NP-F550（机身）──电源线──► HAT（头舱）`，再经 J13/J14 把 **VBATT+DATA** 分给舵机/IMU
- HAT：`AP63205` 输入标称 **5–28 V** → 板载 5 V 给 Zero
- DXL 3P：`1=GND · 2=VBATT · 3=DATA`（HAT J13/J14 与 imu-to-dxl EH 同序）

## Questions to answer（交付）

1. **拓扑是否可行**  
   - 「从机身经 DXL 3P **回灌** HAT `+BATT`」与官方「电池先进 HAT 再出 DXL」的差异、风险（双供电、回流、地回路、颈线载流）  
   - 机身 IMU 板是否适合作为 **电源注入点**（双 EH 中继 / 单座叶子）；铜箔与 PPTC/TVS 是否按「穿堂大电流」设计  

2. **6 V 目标**  
   - XL330 / 母线：6 V 是否在推荐工作区；相对 7.4–8.4 V（2S）的扭矩/压降余量  
   - HAT buck：6 V → 5 V 是否在 AP63205 舒适区（含压差、纹波、Zero+外设电流）  
   - **是否需要稳压**：仅 buck 开环 vs buck+后级 LDO/理想二极管；台架 vs 电池两种场景  

3. **接口与保护**  
   - 机身「电源接口」形态（XT30 / 电池扣 / 台供）与 IMU 3P 的汇合方式  
   - 反接、浪涌、舵机堵转回流对 IMU LDO（3V3）与 HAT 的影响  
   - 与 Type-C 给 Zero 同时供电时的冲突规则（沿用「勿双灌」）  

4. **与在途工作的关系**  
   - 不阻塞 #4 / #7 / #8 的通信排障；本单结论写入 wiki 后再谈改 BOM/改线  

## Deliverables
- [ ] 一页评估写入 wiki（建议新页 `concepts/body-imu-hat-dxl-power-eval.md` 或并入 `board-interconnect` 专节）  
- [ ] 推荐：**采用 / 仅台架实验 / 不采用** + 不可破约束列表  
- [ ] 若采用：草图（电池→6V→哪只 3P→HAT→Zero）与电流预算粗表  
- [ ] Issue 评论摘要；`pm` 裁决是否改互联定稿  

## Constraints
- 规格冲突以 wiki 现行互联为准，直到 pm 改裁决  
- 禁止在未评估前把整机电池只挂在 IMU 链上长期跑舵机堵转工况  
- XL330 与 HAT 电压以手册/现页为准，引用出处  

## Related
- wiki：`board-interconnect` · `bench-power-supply` · `board-hat` · `board-imu-to-dxl` · `np-f550-battery`  
- Issues：#4 HAT TTL · #7/#8 机身 IMU 总线冒烟（通信，非本单电源定稿）  

## assignee-agent
`hardware`（主评估）· `pm` 收口 wiki 裁决；必要时 `structure` 只评线束/腔体走线

title: fix(imu): correct STM32G031 GPIOA peripheral base
body:
## 现象

imu-to-dxl v0.3 已成功烧录，但通过 U2D2 在 COM7、1 Mbps、Protocol 2.0 读取 ID 200 / addr 124 / 12 B 时连续无状态包；原始串口接收为 0 B。

## 根因

firmware/platform/stm32g031/board_g031.c 将 GPIOA_BASE 定义为 AHBPERIPH_BASE (0x40020000)。STM32G031 的 GPIO I/O 端口位于独立 IOPORT 区，GPIOA_BASE 应为 0x50000000（ST CMSIS stm32g031xx.h / RM0444）。RCC 0x40021000 和 USART2 0x40004400 定义不受影响。

## 验收

- [ ] GPIOA 使用 IOPORT_BASE 0x50000000
- [ ] host-test 通过
- [ ] G031 固件可构建
- [ ] 重新烧录后，U2D2 可读取 ID 200 addr 124 length 12

title: [task] HAT TTL Dynamixel bring-up (scope + bench PSU)

milestone.title: v0.1
milestone.description: 复刻官方 Microduck，实现基础功能。

body:
## Goal
Bring up **one** known-good XL330 on the soldered `elec_RPI_Robot_HAT` TTL ports (J13/J14). Isolate the earlier “scan/timeout” failure (U2D2 bench already passed).

## This round (2026-09-16) — audit the method first
Human set this round's scope: **review the test method, scripts and parameters for correctness**, before any bench time. See pm note ([comment](https://github.com/ScrapMeta/microduck-diy/issues/4#issuecomment-5693196184)) for **M1–M6**.

- **M1 / M2 (voltage, current limit): pm already ruled — verify only.** Wiki and this Issue body are updated.
- **M3–M6: hardware to rule on** (confirm / correct / insufficient evidence) and land in the wiki.
- Do **not** wire up and power on this round. Method not settled → a wrong parameter would manufacture new faults.

## Blocked until
Bench gear on site (target: 2026-09-15): **2-ch scope** + **30 V / 10 A** PSU.

## Spec (wiki)
- Procedure: `microduck-diy/wiki/concepts/hat-dxl-bus-debug.md`
- Solder / no-485: `hat-solder-kit.md` §6.4
- Pinout: J13/J14 **1=GND · 2=+BATT · 3=DATA**
- Related: #1 (U2D2 passed) · #2 (Zero system) · #3 (HAT solder)

## Constraints
- PSU: **6.0–6.5 V** — the XL330 is rated **3.7–6.0 V** and these units alarm at **~7.2 V** (over-voltage). J13/J14 pin 2 *is* `+BATT` and the servos are **not** behind the buck, so PSU voltage = servo voltage.
- Current limit: **1 A for the bare-HAT stage**, **2–3 A once the Zero is on the rail** (Zero boot peak exceeds 1 A; a tripped limit collapses the rail and looks like a dead board).
- Never 30 V. One servo only; same unit that still answers on U2D2.
- Do **not** dual-feed Zero Type-C and `+BATT`
- RS-485 (U8/J3/J11) not required; keep R29 / U5–U7

## Acceptance
- [ ] U2D2 still sees that servo (1 Mbps, Protocol 2.0)
- [ ] HAT pin 2 = PSU voltage (**6.0–6.5 V**); 5 V / 3V3 OK
- [ ] `/dev/ttyS2` present; `serial-getty@ttyS2` **masked**; `console=display`; `fuser` clean
- [ ] Scope: idle DATA ≈ 3.3 V; ping shows host packet; reply packet with servo on
- [ ] Software ping/read ID succeeds on `/dev/ttyS2`
- [ ] Comment this Issue with waveforms / `armbianEnv` / blockers; tick wiki §7
- [ ] Method audit answered (M1–M6) and landed in the wiki

## assignee-agent
hardware (bench + method audit); pm tracks
